profile.visual_style: Minimalist architectural photography with soft natural morning light, slate surfaces, muted brass accents, and shallow depth of field

scenes.title: A Finite Resource
scenes.narration: Clean water is finite, and meaningful stewardship starts with everyday routines at home.
scenes.image_prompt: A minimalist glass carafe and a single lowball tumbler of clear still water resting on a polished dark slate table in soft morning light

scenes.title: Simple Adjustments
scenes.narration: Shut off the faucet while brushing your teeth, and repair leaking fixtures promptly. Even a minor drip wastes significant volume over time.
scenes.image_prompt: A modern matte-black bathroom faucet over a smooth stone basin, capturing a single suspended droplet of water poised to fall

scenes.title: Smarter Showers
scenes.narration: Choose brief showers over full baths to immediately reduce your daily consumption.
scenes.image_prompt: A luxury walk-in rain shower enclosure with frosted glass panels and gentle steam clinging to clean architectural lines

scenes.title: Optimizing Appliances
scenes.narration: Wait for a full load before running the washing machine to make every cycle count.
scenes.image_prompt: A sleek, integrated front-load washing machine set flush into dark timber cabinetry in an uncluttered utility room

scenes.title: Repurposing Rainwater
scenes.narration: Outside, collect rainwater in collection barrels and use it to maintain your garden and household plants.
scenes.image_prompt: An elegant charcoal ceramic rainwater collection vessel resting on a bluestone patio beside lush green foliage

scenes.title: Compounding Impact
scenes.narration: Every drop matters. Small, disciplined daily habits compound into lasting change.
scenes.image_prompt: A tranquil interior courtyard with floor-to-ceiling glass walls overlooking a minimalist stone garden under calm overcast skies
